name: munchkin-production-telemetry
title: Munchkin production telemetry
description: Low-cardinality metrics for the Munchkin production API, readiness boundary and bounded gameplay interactions.

chart.title: Request rate
chart.description: Aggregated application request counter across the game and web services.

chart.title: HTTP errors
chart.description: 5xx request rate remains bounded by the alert definition; 4xx is shown for context.

chart.title: HTTP p95 latency
chart.description: Histogram percentile over the bounded route-class and status dimensions.

chart.title: Readiness and PostgreSQL dependency
chart.description: The readiness route is backed by the bounded PostgreSQL probe; a 5xx series is the dependency failure signal.

target.query: series_sum({project="folder__b1g55l8i2mtpv23b5ql7", cluster="production", service="munchkin-game", env="production", name="http.server.request.count", http.route.class="health_ready", http.response.status_class="5xx"})

series_sum({project="folder__b1g55l8i2mtpv23b5ql7", cluster="production", service="munchkin-game", env="production", name="http.server.request.count", http.route.class="health_ready", http.response.status_class="2xx"})

chart.title: Bounded gameplay interactions
chart.description: Interaction outcomes and timeouts use allowlisted enums only; no game, player, card or command identifiers are labels.

text.text: Deploy and migration revision: inspect the `service.revision` resource attribute on the trace and the immutable release evidence. Migration contract: `health-migrations-v1`. Traces are retained for 4 days; metrics expire after 30 days without new values. No logs are ingested.
